case.summary: The transaction of $1,000.03 was reviewed after the real-time model flagged it with a high score, but the investigation concluded it was legitimate and the case was closed as legitimate. Fraud probability was low at 4 % and most evidence pointed to a genuine customer, including a new device profile and an anonymous email domain that historically indicate genuine activity. The model’s own score was treated as a weak input because scores above 0.7 are usually legitimate. The customer successfully completed step-up authentication, confirming the purchase. The transaction was allowed and the case was closed with no fraud finding.
